invoicing.policy: Invoicing 2.12.0 preserves the locked Parts 1–10 baseline and completes Part 11 Credit Notes & Refunds with line-level and quick credit-note issuance, source-invoice offsets, reusable customer credit balances, application to other invoices, cash/bank refunds, reversal-safe application/refund ledgers, idempotent credit operations, dedicated credit-refund numbering, accounting postings, cancellation safeguards, operator lifecycle history, and separate cash-payment versus credit settlement reporting. Future changes must keep Invoicing, ERP integration, platform closure, app-surface, visibility, core-hardening, TypeScript, migration dry-run and production deployment gates green.
